Share typed functional IR machinery where justified; implement each type system, pattern matching, laziness/effects and runtime representation separately.
Share reader/AST and closure infrastructure only for reviewed compatible profiles; preserve macros, evaluation order, numeric towers and dynamic binding.
Use actual OTP/BEAM hosts and shared process/message transport; qualify each source grammar, pattern semantics, supervision and concurrency behavior.
Expand the real Python/JavaScript typed profiles with measured compatibility helpers; bind original runtimes for unsupported objects/modules/effects.
Share typed array/storage and exact marshaling with explicit rounding/layout contracts; qualify every statistical function, toolbox and licensed runtime separately.

Implement category-appropriate parse/validate/process/serialize behavior, Unicode and normalization; use exact document/style versions and independent roundtrip oracles.
Use real build/configuration hosts and resolved dependency graphs; qualify evaluation, environment, command effects and cancellation, beyond accepting syntax.

Use real elaborators/simulators or shader compilers plus qualifying devices; preserve scheduling, precision, layout, linkage and target-specific execution semantics.
Use exact ISA/ABI/device profiles and actual assemblers/VMs; verify instruction effects, memory/layout and observable native behavior.
Bind actual shell/automation hosts; preserve expansion, quoting, environment, process status, pipelines and external effects under explicit capabilities.
Use native proof/query engines and declared logic models; qualify unification, search, termination assumptions and trusted proof checkers.
Install genuine native tools where available; implement record/storage/control semantics, fixed/free dialects and exact proprietary host dependencies.
Share a typed stack IR only with reviewed word/dictionary contracts; qualify stack effects, memory, numeric semantics and each native environment.
Implement each actual execution model with independently authored step traces and resource limits; resemblance or a keyword list cannot establish equivalence.
Resolve the actual domain/specification first, identify real upstream tools, and implement its category-appropriate contract; family classification remains provisional.
Validate framing/prompts and replay pinned messages against the actual host; distinguish logs/diagnostics from executable programming-language sources.

external_dependencies.next_action: Provide an authorized SAP ABAP host/API or locally install an entitled SAP developer image; qualify its exact ABAP release. A Linux lexer or transpiler is not an ABAP host.
external_dependencies.requires: SAP ABAP application server (explicit release), authorized development account and required SAP entitlement

external_dependencies.next_action: Connect an authorized macOS runner and record macOS/AppleScript versions; run native suites and target-application fixtures there.
external_dependencies.requires: macOS host with osacompile/osascript and permission for application automation

external_dependencies.next_action: Select v1 or v2 in the specification profile; install the matching runtime on an authorized Windows runner and test GUI/COM/keyboard behavior.
external_dependencies.requires: Windows runner and an exact AutoHotkey v1/v2 runtime matching the selected dialect

external_dependencies.next_action: Install AutoIt on an authorized Windows runner and qualify its interpreter, COM and GUI capabilities; Linux discovery cannot qualify them.
external_dependencies.requires: Windows runner with version-pinned AutoIt and authorized GUI automation session

external_dependencies.next_action: Resolve the exact IDL version and provide a licensed runtime; an interface-definition parser is not the IDL numerical runtime.
external_dependencies.requires: Versioned licensed NV5/Exelis IDL runtime, distinct from OMG/Web interface definition languages

external_dependencies.next_action: Provide MATLAB or select an explicitly limited Octave-compatible profile; do not certify full MATLAB/toolbox semantics from Octave results.
external_dependencies.requires: Licensed MATLAB with explicit version and toolbox entitlement profile

external_dependencies.next_action: Replay independently pinned transcripts on the matching licensed MATLAB host; separately qualify prompt/output normalization.
external_dependencies.requires: Versioned MATLAB host for transcript replay and the transcript's toolboxes

external_dependencies.next_action: Provide a licensed local or remote SAS runtime and independent SAS conformance/acceptance jobs; Python/R substitutes do not certify SAS.
external_dependencies.requires: Licensed SAS deployment with declared Base SAS/Viya version and relevant modules

external_dependencies.next_action: Supply the licensed runtime and entitlement, then run actual Stata language and statistics acceptance cases.
